name: Tomoshiro Masaki
source:
The protagonist of this story.
Masaki is an ordinary student. One day, he decided to chase after a [url=/c86442]mysterious girl[/url] to the shrine, little did he know that's when his daily life took a drastic change. The day after, Masaki realized that he has been cursed by a ghost. He has to follow what it says, otherwise he will die.
Masaki is a very decent player in his school's baseball club, which is in total contrast with his sloppy studying. He is also bad at making conversation with girls, even to his childhood friend [url=/c86434]Miki[/url].
